name: get_project_env
description:
Retrieve a single project environment variable by ID. The response can include the variable's value, which may be a secret. Use filter_project_envs to list a project's variables and find IDs.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{idOrName}/env/{id} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

id.description: The unique ID for the environment variable to get the decrypted value.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
